steps.content: The modified sand ship tears along the edge of the ruins, fast as lightning.
As the ruined outline looms, distant figures sharpen into view: the Luminaris Society envoys, leading the farland delegation step by cautious step into the decaying maw of the site.
Hypatia tenses to move, but Rust's hand shoots out to stop her.
His hand points subtly to the side. There, people dressed like refugees appear to be resting, but their eyes are active, scanning their surroundings with vigilant care.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Those refugees... they're impostors?
Rust nods.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Your former colleagues have come prepared as well. A direct confrontation would be inconvenient. Best to avoid it.
He turns toward Hypatia as he says it, and a faint, involuntary smile appears.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Looks like you already have an idea.
Hypatia has already unfolded a survey map and begun marking it with swift, precise notations.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Routes... pathways... confirmed contamination zones... If I were the Luminaris Society... here... would be the ideal point for an ambush.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: So... we reach the site ahead of them. Disable the traps... then block the routes leading deeper in.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Would a plan like that work?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Well done, Miss Campbell. Remarkable progress. Truly a genius in the making... I'd say you're ready for your final examination.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...This is hardly the time for jokes.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I'm not joking. In fact, I've already had your test designed.
With a smile, he folds up the map and hands it to Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: A rescue competition. Master versus apprentice. We take separate routes, locate the delegation leaders, and extract them, by persuasion or by force, your choice. The objective: get them out alive.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Victory conditions... we tally which route extracts more leaders? If you win—or if I lose—either way, Agent Campbell graduates with full honors.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Oh, and one major stipulation: the agent must return unharmed. Excessive risk resulting in injury means automatic disqualification.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: So, can you handle this on your own, Hypatia?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But why—
He raises a hand, gently but firmly halting her question before it can be spoken.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: We all have our stubborn streak, don't we? Consider this a personal favor, and I know you're more than capable of seeing it through.

Hypatia opens her mouth to speak, then closes it again. Both instinct and logic scream that something is wrong, yet she swallows her objections. The look in Rust's eyes... it holds a determination she has never seen before.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Then you must be careful as well, sir.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Well said. Do your best out there, top student.
Deep Within the Furor Ruins

Even with the Black Ring destroyed, the contamination here remains lethally potent. The air swims with dark gray particles; the ground, a sludge-covered ruin, is split by countless fissures like infected wounds in the earth.

The area is a fortress of hidden threats. Past the specialized devices at the heart of each trap, Hypatia senses more than a dozen Underground Puppets. These creatures are lurking in the shadows, their locations given away by the faint Aurum Secretum resonance in their cores.

Immersed in a Mania field where hallucination and pain entwine, Hypatia clings to her focus, hoping that she can disarm every trap without being noticed.
Or... she could strike first!
A golden streak pierces the gloom. An Underground Puppet freezes in place. She closes the distance in a heartbeat and cleanly severs its neck.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: That's the third one...
Footsteps echo from behind. Hypatia melts into the shadows.
A net of Aurum Secretum erupts from the ground, wrapping an enemy in a swift, crushing embrace.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: The fourth...
And so it continues: the fifth, the sixth, the seventh... until finally, silence. Only the gurgle of contaminated fluid and Hypatia's ragged breathing remain.
Suddenly, a shadow lunges. Her body moves on instinct—crouch, sidestep, strike. Blinding gold light flares. The last enemy pitches backward into the murk.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: You... were the last.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: A shame, but when it comes to Aurum Secretum... you were simply outclassed.

With the Puppets eliminated, Hypatia turns her focus to the next target: specialized devices modified from abandoned DisCity survey equipment. They must serve some purpose beyond merely framing people.

Deftly, she removes the outer casing. Inside, an Aurum Secretum structure confirms her suspicion. These devices are using resonance to deliberately guide the ruin's contamination, funneling it deep into the heart of the trap.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: To think they'd take my creation... and twist it into something this vile.
The girl's fist tightens. She once took pride in creating Aurum Secretum. But now, faced with her own technology turned into a weapon... should she feel remorse?
Hypatia shakes her head, forcing the thought away. This isn't the time for doubt. She centers her focus, ready to destroy the devices.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Disconnecting the primary circuit... done.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: This is...!!
The instant the device is disabled, black sludge surges together, forming one Puppet after another from the ground itself. Their focus snaps to the only target in sight—her.
